qwen-shares-local.json.placement: Requester and both providers were three processes on one trusted Linux x86-64 test host with two cores and four hardware threads.

qwen-shares-two-machine.json.placement: Requester and provider B on the same Linux test host; provider A on a separate Apple Silicon machine reached over SSH on the local network.
qwen-shares-two-machine.json.transport: one SSH pipe and one local-process pipe; the SSH host was not pinned by this route
qwen-shares-two-machine.json.timingCaveat: The Apple machine was running other sessions' test suites and browser rehearsals during this run, and its copy of the provider code is not attested; its elapsed time is not a clean measurement.

comparisonWithRetainedReceipts.notMatched: Different mechanism and guarantee. The homomorphic receipts hide the input from one evaluator under a cryptographic assumption; this route hides it from each of two providers only if they do not collude. Elapsed times are shown side by side, not as a matched benchmark.

limitations: One public four-token fixture, one run per placement; not a latency distribution or a quality result.
Both providers were operated by the same person, and in one run shared a host with each other and the requester, so the non-collusion assumption was not exercised.
No provider misbehaved in these runs, so they show completeness and cost, not detection. Detection is exercised by test_shares.py.

The requester process also loaded the reference model to compare results after the route closed, and computed its own anchors from the public weights; its peak memory therefore says nothing about a requester that holds no weights.
Providers ran NumPy on CPU. No GPU kernel exists for this field arithmetic.
Two independent automated reviews examined earlier versions; this prime-field version has not been independently reviewed.

The providers' coefficient files were hashed against the plan's weight identities by the providers themselves; the requester relies on its anchors, which in these runs it computed from the same public weights.
revisionNote: The runs used a working tree whose listed source files are byte-identical to this revision; the commit was made a few minutes after the runs.
supersededReceipts: Receipts for the first version (integers modulo 2^64) are in repository history at commit 9975f02c5: same tokens and zero difference, 137.3 s and 167.4 s.
